ownership_and_bounds.snapshot_lifetime: One bounded process-lifetime snapshot, matching existing global font registries; replacement destroys retained pattern/config references
ownership_and_bounds.charset_lifetime: Borrowed only while referenced font patterns remain retained
ownership_and_bounds.invalidation: Actual config and system/application fontset identities, counts, ordered pattern pointers and native font generation; epochs invalidate memoized optimized results and diagnostic mismatch advances epoch
ownership_and_bounds.threading: Existing font_mu serializes matcher/cache access; concurrent external Fontconfig mutation is not a newly supported API
ownership_and_bounds.fallback: Other runtime versions, empty/oversized fontsets, missing/multiple charsets, custom file/index/FT-face requests, large prefix groups and other unsupported requests retain original matching behavior; empty/oversized paths retain baseline memo semantics
ownership_and_bounds.oracle_mismatch: Explicit validation failure; runtime diagnostic fails closed to original result and disables that snapshot optimization
